label: caiso 17 pnw-hydro-collapse (PROBE)
definition: (PROBE — structural correction, NOT adopted as default.) Adds PNW_hydro_base to the --caiso-import-solar-shape collapse set. The solved dispatch shows PNW_hydro_base (the COI firm-hydro import block, $28) is the 72%-loaded MARGINAL setter of the flat $28 midday floor — once DSW_solar_PV/PNW_midC collapse they load first and leave it as the margin — so its prior 'must-take, do-not-collapse' exclusion was empirically wrong. Collapsing it lowers the midday floor $28->$25 (h12 resid +12.9->+10.7) and improves the negative tail toward actual (count 407->593 vs 755, recall 50->67%), but moves the MEAN only 42.0->41.28 and drops neg precision 92->85% (and over-counts <=$5: 1034 vs 923). The full -$20 collapse overshoots the moderate summer/winter midday (reality there is low-but-positive ~$15-30, not negative); a tighter band (24/8) only recovers precision to 87%. Reverted from the default: it fails the >=90% precision guardrail and does not close the body. p50/p95 unchanged (peaks safe).
